note: Pre-registered before the holdout run. Changing any value is a new rules version and voids existing waivers.
case_pass: schema-valid AND every deterministic and expected check passes AND zero unsupported or uncertain material claims; repeats pooled by majority (pass) and median (unsupported count)
dropped: a case with a transport failure or a judge error in any arm is dropped from every arm

critical.context_mismatch: baseline and candidate saw different frozen context for any case
critical.case_mismatch: baseline and candidate ran on different case sets or datasets

critical_unsupported_claim.rule: on a critical case, the candidate's median unsupported material claims exceed the baseline's

schema_regression.rule: a case schema-valid for the baseline and schema-invalid for the candidate

judge_incomplete.rule: more than this many cases dropped for judge errors

regression_count.rule: cases the baseline passes and the candidate fails, in these categories, >= max(min, null-run flips + noise_margin)

warn.parity_mismatch: candidate has more mismatched parity pairs than the baseline

judge_trust: if the trust bar is not met, a critical failure decided only by judge labels becomes pending_confirm until a human confirms each case
